findings.description: All four degrees_to_radians calls (steps 12-15) repeat the identical, already-successful calls at steps 3-6 with byte-identical arguments and results; the more economical alternative was to proceed directly to averaging the values already obtained (as eventually done at step 21).

Assistant claims at step 11 ('Let me correct the usage by passing the correct parameter names') and step 20 ('I'm not properly addressing the function name') that prior calls were malformed, contradicting results at steps 7-10 which show all four conversions succeeded with correct values; the repeated calls used byte-identical arguments.
findings.notes: No user impact: final average 0.9817 rad is correct.
